title: metadax.refusals/0.2
description: The durable refusal set -- the standing 'never show me X / stop suggesting Y' directives a learner has issued. It is the protected projection of the companion log's refusal entries. Any engine handed a learner record MUST read this set and suppress matching content BEFORE it reaches the guide or learner (offer-never-push). A refusal is never inferred, never expires on its own, and is only ever removed by an explicit withdrawal carrying the same refusal_id.

directive.description: never_show: content matching target is never surfaced. stop_suggesting: it is never proposed/offered, though the learner may still ask. never_carry: it is never carried across courses as a carry-over.

target.description: a slug for what is refused
